entry.title: Scope Maximo empty-state and page count to the target table
entry.description: A detail view can contain several tables; an empty-state message from an unrelated table must not make a populated target table appear empty. Match the tCount id to the parsed target table prefix before deciding its page range.
applicable_when: Parsing a Maximo detail view with multiple tables
advantages: Supports complete pagination of the intended table
disadvantages: Requires the target table prefix and count id convention
recommended_when: Reading related records from a Maximo detail subtab over HTTP
notes: Observed in the 2026-10-02 fault-notice linked work-order recording and validated with a live HTTP-only query.
Deduplicate linked work orders by business key after collecting all pages; retain first occurrence order.
